clue.text: Silences a couple of musicians with backing group

indicators.note: a couple of means the opening two letters of the word musicians are taken
backing says the synonym for group is read from back to front

parts.note: a set is a group

explanation.surface: A band's rhythm section turns the volume down on a pair of its own players.
explanation.definitionFit: Mutes as a verb means quietens or muffles, the same sense as silences.

clue.text: Crowds second qualified surgeon

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a second
BS is Bachelor of Surgery, a surgeon's qualification

explanation.surface: A second qualified surgeon arrives as the crowds build in a busy hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: Mobs are large disorderly gatherings of people, so a synonym for crowds as a noun.

clue.text: 10-day struggle to acquire new clothes somewhere around Newcastle

indicators.note: struggle suggests the letters wrestling with each other into a new order

parts.note: the number 10 written out in words
wear is clothing, as in menswear

explanation.surface: A ten-day battle to buy new outfits somewhere in the north-east of England.
explanation.walkthrough: '10' is the number written out, and 'struggle' signals the rearrangement. Tyne and Wear is the metropolitan county containing Newcastle upon Tyne in north-east England.
explanation.definitionFit: The metropolitan county surrounding Newcastle upon Tyne is named after its two rivers.

clue.text: Quiet boat comes on school of fish

indicators.note: comes on says the following letter is added next in a down answer

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
Noah's ark is a boat

explanation.surface: A silent vessel arrives upon a school of fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharks are large predatory fish of the sea.

clue.text: Man of property right to replace last bit of spread containing evidence of cat

indicators.note: containing says the altered spread wraps around the cat's sound
to replace last bit of says the final letter of the spread is swapped for the abbreviation of right

parts.note: honey is a spread for toast
a miaow or meow is the sound that shows a cat is present

explanation.surface: A landlord finds cat traces in the jam and wants it replaced.
explanation.walkthrough: HONEY loses its last letter Y to R, giving HONER, which is opened up to hold MEOW.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who owns the house they live in is a person of property.

clue.text: Is optimistic about 1/9 of gardening equipment

indicators.note: about says the optimistic verb goes around the date letters

parts.note: someone optimistic hopes
the date 1/9 is the first of September, written SEP plus I, the Roman one

explanation.surface: Someone is hopeful about a small fraction of their garden kit.
explanation.walkthrough: '1/9' looks like a fraction but is a British-style date, day then month: the first of September, SEP and I.
explanation.definitionFit: Hosepipes are flexible tubes used to water a garden, so a piece of gardening kit.

clue.text: A short time on the phone gets a place to stay

indicators.note: on says the first piece sits above the second in this down answer

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a short time
tel is the abbreviation for telephone

explanation.surface: A quick phone call secures somewhere to spend the night.
explanation.definitionFit: A motel is a roadside hotel for motorists, a lodging for the night.

clue.text: Beat more than a million inside church

parts.note: over means more than, as in over fifty

indicators.note: inside says the article and abbreviation sit within the church letters

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Raised more than a million in a church collection and beat the target.
explanation.definitionFit: Overcame is the past tense of defeat or conquer, as beat is here.

clue.text: Born partly bioengineered

indicators.note: partly says only some of the letters of the following word are used

explanation.surface: Something born partly through genetic engineering.
explanation.definitionFit: Née, French for born, introduces a woman's maiden name.

clue.text: Pay rises in Newmarket are numerous

indicators.note: rises says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Pay increases at the racing town are many.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'rises' reads the letters upwards; the run sits across 'Newmarket are numerous'. Newmarket is the English horseracing town.
explanation.definitionFit: To remunerate someone is to reward them with money for work done, a formal verb meaning pay.

clue.text: UN man thanks a thousand small egg producers

parts.note: Ban Ki-moon was Secretary-General of the United Nations
ta is British informal for thanks
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: A United Nations official thanks a thousand little egg-layers.
explanation.definitionFit: Bantams are small breeds of domestic chicken, so hens that produce eggs.

clue.text: Joiner that's born in Chelsea, say

indicators.note: in says the letters go inside the football side

parts.note: Chelsea is a London football club, an example of a team
ie, id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A carpenter who was born in a fashionable part of London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Joiner' suggests a carpenter, but the definition is a beam that joins the feet of rafters.
explanation.definitionFit: A tie beam links the lower ends of a pair of rafters, so it joins parts of a roof.

clue.text: Male koala in space excited by way to find out the time

definitions.text: way to find out the time

indicators.note: excited suggests agitated letters jumping into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A male koala floating in space gets excited by a route to learning the hour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'If you want to know the time, ask a policeman' is an old British saying, from when police officers carried watches.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase comes from a traditional British saying advising people how to learn the hour.

clue.text: Spooner's fish question to be very significant

indicators.note: Spooner's says the opening sounds of the two words are swapped

parts.note: hake is a fish
a mystery is an open question

explanation.surface: The Reverend Spooner poses a question about a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To make history is to do something so important it will be remembered, an idiom.

clue.text: Espionage equipment made it open accidentally

indicators.note: accidentally says the letters fall into place by chance in a new order

explanation.surface: A spy's kit was opened by mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-time pad is an unbreakable cipher key, each sheet used once, issued to spies.

clue.text: Signals given to embattled soldiers at last

indicators.note: at last says the final letter of each of the following words is taken

explanation.surface: Signals are finally sent to troops under siege.
explanation.definitionFit: Nods are small head movements used as signals of agreement or instruction.

clue.text: One filling boxes containing drug medium and advanced medical device

indicators.note: containing says the packer's letters go around the three abbreviations

parts.note: a packer is someone who fills boxes
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A warehouse worker packing drugs and an advanced medical device.
explanation.definitionFit: A pacemaker is an implanted electronic device that regulates the heartbeat.

clue.text: Sparkle you finally leave in the middle

indicators.note: in says these letters are put within the middle's synonym

parts.note: the core is the middle of something

indicators.note: finally says just the closing letter of you is used

parts.note: scat is a command to go away

explanation.surface: An instruction to sparkle: you finally exit centre stage.
explanation.definitionFit: To coruscate is to flash or glitter, a literary verb meaning sparkle.

clue.text: Things the French stuffed under truck

indicators.note: stuffed under says the French word is placed below the truck in this down answer

parts.note: an artic is an articulated lorry, a large truck
les is French for the, in the plural

explanation.surface: French goods crammed underneath a lorry.
explanation.definitionFit: Articles are items or objects, as in articles of clothing.

clue.text: Surprisingly tie horse to Republican thinker

indicators.note: surprisingly says the letters land in an unexpected new order

explanation.surface: Unexpectedly, someone ties a horse to a Republican politician.
explanation.definitionFit: A theoriser forms theories, so is a speculative thinker.

clue.text: Man putting on weight to get sharper

indicators.note: putting on says the man dons the weight, which wraps around him

parts.note: he stands for a man

explanation.surface: A man gaining weight hoping to become sharper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get sharper' is read as transitive, to make something sharper.
explanation.definitionFit: To whet is to sharpen a blade, so to make it keener.

clue.text: Bark from this black when prepared

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black on pencils
as can mean when, as in as I left
set means prepared or ready

explanation.surface: A tree's black bark, once ready.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bark' suggests a tree's covering, but it is a dog's bark.
explanation.definitionFit: A basset is a short-legged hound, the kind of dog a bark comes from.

clue.text: Swinging places Algerians busily put rugs round

indicators.note: round says the mats wrap around the rearranged letters

parts.note: mats are small rugs

indicators.note: busily suggests the letters bustling into a new order

explanation.surface: Busy Algerians lay rugs around the dance floor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swinging' suggests dance, but means a constituency that swings between parties at a British election.
explanation.definitionFit: Marginal seats are constituencies won by small majorities, so likely to swing at elections.

clue.text: No time to check over sound system

indicators.note: No says the abbreviation for time is removed from the check

parts.note: an audit is a check of accounts
O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: No time to inspect the sound system again.
explanation.definitionFit: Audio equipment reproduces recorded sound, so it is a sound system.

clue.text: Side to move carefully

definitions.meaning: a border or rim, as in the side of a table
to advance slowly and cautiously, as along a ledge

explanation.definitionFit: As a noun it means a border or brink; as a verb it means inch along.

clue.text: Chose to tackle large drunk

indicators.note: to tackle says the chosen word takes hold of the letter for large, enclosing it

parts.note: picked means chose

explanation.surface: Selected to tackle a large, drunk opponent.
explanation.definitionFit: Pickled is British slang for very intoxicated, preserved in alcohol.

clue.text: Restore to health, missing hand signal

indicators.note: missing says a letter is dropped from the healing verb

parts.note: to cure is to make well
R for right, as in right hand

explanation.surface: Healing someone without a hand signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A cue is a prompt to act, such as an actor's signal to enter.

clue.text: Commercial featuring graduate about to run away

indicators.note: featuring says the advert has the following letters inside it

parts.note: an ad is a television commercial
a BSc is a Bachelor of Science, a graduate
on means about, as in a talk on art

explanation.surface: An advert starring a graduate who is about to flee.
explanation.definitionFit: To abscond is to leave secretly, typically to escape arrest, so to flee.

clue.text: Gut and trim fish — note tails are required?

parts.note: to dress a fish or bird is to clean it for cooking
cod is a fish
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: Instructions for preparing fish: remove the tails.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tails' suggests the fish but means a tailcoat, formal evening wear.
explanation.definitionFit: A rule saying formal tailcoats must be worn is a dress rule for an event.

clue.text: Herb your old people don't finish

parts.note: thy is the archaic form of your

indicators.note: don't finish says the final letter of the people word is dropped

parts.note: men means people

explanation.surface: Your aged relatives never get to the end of their herb.
explanation.definitionFit: Thyme is an aromatic culinary plant of the mint family.
